changes: Created the initial HACS custom integration scaffold for Assist Memo.
Renamed the integration identity from Assist Memo to Assist News and updated its domain to assist_news.
Added an Assist LLM tool that parses up to 12 major headlines from Naver's Yonhap News press page.
Added multi-publisher config entries using Naver press IDs, per-publisher Assist tools, duplicate prevention, and migration for the original Yonhap entry.
Added extraction of up to 1,000 characters of article body text per major headline for Assist LLM summaries, with article requests limited to three concurrent fetches.
Made the per-article body character limit configurable during publisher setup and through the options flow, defaulting to 1,000 characters.
Added a per-publisher article briefing length setting to config and options flows, defaulting to 100 characters, and included the target length in Assist prompts.
Changed each configured publisher into a selectable LLM API registered with async_register_api and unregistered on entry unload; corrected integration_type to service.
Updated Assist guidance to omit article links by default and provide them only when explicitly requested.
Removed overlapping briefing guidance from the API prompt and consolidated article count and configured text limits in the dynamic tool description.
Instructed Assist to preserve each article's original title and summarize only the body in a complete, factual sentence within the configured briefing length.
Made the number of major news articles configurable per publisher from 1 to 30, defaulting to 12, and applied it to the tool description and fetch limit.
Cleaned parsed news titles and article bodies by decoding HTML entities and removing control, zero-width, and decorative symbols while preserving punctuation and Hanja.
Removed double quotes and literal backslashes from parsed titles and article bodies so JSON tool output does not need to escape embedded double quotes.
Preserved headline quotation marks and punctuation during parsing; JSON backslash escapes are serialization syntax and are not literal news text.
Added a final response review instruction to compare copied headlines with tool output and recheck spelling, names, organizations, and numbers against article bodies.
Simplified the Assist API prompt to: This tool provides news.
Clarified the tool description to summarize only the article body within approximately the configured briefing character limit.
Updated the tool description to expose title, time, and body fields without mentioning links, and to request title/body separation with a body-only summary within the configured length.
Strengthened the tool description to require verbatim headlines, body-grounded summaries without added claims, and links only when requested.
Translated the Assist API prompt and news tool instructions into English while directing the model to answer in the user's language.
Simplified the news tool result to an articles array with per-article title, time, body, and link fields, removing redundant top-level metadata.
Changed the news tool result to a structured text block with explicit per-article title, time, body, and link labels.
Reverted the news tool response to its original JSON structure after structured-text output did not improve model summaries.
Made calm news anchor delivery the default for spoken briefs, with short formal Korean sentences and transitions between articles.
Added English and Korean installation and setup guides, updated repository links, and set the public integration version to 1.0.0.
Added the Ko-fi badge and instructions for finding Naver News publisher IDs to both READMEs.
Aligned the Korean README installation badge with the Home Assistant Marketplace badge in the English README.
Added the Marketplace validation workflow with HACS and hassfest checks.
Added a news article copyright notice to both READMEs.
Licensed the project code under MIT and linked the license from both READMEs.
Added a Marketplace brand icon and news category, and removed the literal URL from the configuration translation.
Guided spoken briefings to cover the five Ws and one H using facts stated in the article body.
Required complete ordered briefings of returned articles by default while honoring explicit requests for fewer or filtered articles.
Consolidated documentation into the Korean README.md and removed the separate localized README.
Added publisher-filtered news search with up to three numbered results and snapshot-based selected-article summaries of about 500 Korean characters.
Documented the Edge TTS fork with streaming fixes for long spoken news briefings.
